items.title_original: Drawn Stainless Steel Sinks From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of the Expedited First and Second Sunset Reviews of the Countervailing Duty Order; Correction
items.summary_zh: 10月6日公告2026-20481纠正2018和2023两次反补贴日落复审终裁中的错误：其他企业补贴率原写8.61%，应为8.51%。这是历史公告数字更正，不是对所有中国钢材新增税率。
items.summary_en: Notice 2026-20481 corrects the all-others subsidy rate in the 2018 and 2023 sunset results from 8.61% to 8.51%. It is a correction of historical notices.
items.impact_zh: 水槽出口及美国进口商应更新案件档案，由律师核对现行保证金、清算指令及历史记录，不能直接把8.51%当所有企业当前税率。
items.impact_en: Update case records and have counsel check current deposits and liquidation instructions. Do not apply 8.51% indiscriminately.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice in the Federal Register of July 25, 2018 and October 20, 2023 in which Commerce announced the final results of the first and second sunset reviews of the countervailing duty (CVD) order on drawn stainless steel sinks from the People's Republic of China (China). These notices incorrectly stated an all-others rate of 8.61 percent.
items.coverage: 已核对Federal Register正文及公开审阅PDF；未核对各企业当前CBP保证金指令。

items.title_zh: 美国对华定尺碳钢板第五次日落复审终裁：撤令可能导致倾销延续
items.title_en: US fifth sunset review finds dumping likely to recur for Chinese cut-to-length carbon steel plate
items.title_original: Certain Cut-to-Length Carbon Steel Plate From the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation: Final Results of the Expedited Fifth Sunset Reviews of the Antidumping Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部第五次快速日落复审终裁（A-570-849；91 FR 63265）认定，撤销对中国和俄罗斯定尺碳钢板反倾销令可能导致倾销继续或再现；可能继续或再现的加权平均倾销幅度最高为中国128.59%、俄罗斯185.00%。由于没有被调查方提交实质答复，商务部采用120天快速复审程序；结果自2026年10月5日起适用。
items.summary_en: Commerce's expedited fifth sunset-review results (A-570-849; 91 FR 63265) find that revoking the China and Russia CTL-plate AD orders would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping. Margins likely to prevail are up to 128.59% for China and 185.00% for Russia. No respondent interested party filed a substantive response, so Commerce used the 120-day expedited procedure. The results apply from 5 October 2026.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：128.59%是日落复审中的“可能继续或再现”幅度，不是所有中国出口商自本公告起统一适用的新现金保证金率。本公告支持维持现有反倾销令，但仍应跟踪USITC损害复审及后续续令公告；涉美定尺板业务应继续按企业适用税率报价，不应假设措施即将撤销。
items.impact_en: Assessment: 128.59% is the sunset-review margin likely to prevail, not a new uniform cash-deposit rate for every Chinese exporter. The finding supports continuation of the order, subject to the injury-side review and subsequent continuation notice. US CTL-plate business should keep using company-specific applicable rates and not assume the order will lapse.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) finds that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) orders on certain cut-to-length carbon steel plate (CTL plate) from the People's Republic of China (China) and the Russian Federation (Russia) would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping, at the levels indicated in the "Final Results of Sunset Reviews" section of this notice.
items.coverage: Official Federal Register full notice reviewed, including final-results margins; the linked Issues and Decision Memorandum was not treated as separately reviewed.

items.title_zh: 欧盟公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格：82.32欧元
items.title_en: EU publishes Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price of €82.32
items.title_original: Q3 2026 CBAM Certificate price now available!
items.summary_zh: 欧委会10月5日公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格为每张82.32欧元；第二季度为75.28欧元，环比上升约9.4%。季度价格按欧盟碳排放配额拍卖成交价加权平均计算，适用于对应季度进口CBAM商品的隐含排放；2026年证书从2027年2月起在统一中央平台购买。
items.summary_en: On 5 October the Commission published the Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price at €82.32, about 9.4% above Q2's €75.28. The quarterly price is the weighted average of EU ETS auction clearing prices and applies to embedded emissions in CBAM goods imported during the relevant quarter; 2026 certificates become purchasable on the common central platform from February 2027.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：钢铁出口商应把82.32欧元作为第三季度对应证书的官方价格输入，与欧盟进口商更新碳成本测算和合同调价假设；它不是钢材吨税，也不能脱离经核验的产品隐含排放、免费分配调整和已支付碳价直接换算应缴额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: use €82.32 as the official certificate-price input for Q3 and update carbon-cost and contract assumptions with EU importers. It is not a per-tonne steel tariff and cannot determine liability without verified embedded emissions, free-allocation adjustment and eligible carbon prices already paid.
items.source_excerpt: 05 Oct 2026 Q3 2026 CBAM Certificate price now available! Each 2026 quarterly price is calculated by the Commission in the first calendar week after the quarter ends, based on publicly available EU ETS auction information.
items.coverage: Official DG TAXUD price table and methodology page checked on 5 October 2026.

items.title_zh: 美国更正对华对焊管件公告：明确追溯暂停清算和现金保证金
items.title_en: US Commerce correction clarifies retroactive suspension for China-origin butt-weld pipe fittings processed in Vietnam
items.title_original: Certain Carbon Steel Butt-Weld Pipe Fittings From the People's Republic of China: Notice of Court Decision Not in Harmony With Final Covered Merchandise Determination and Notice of Amended Covered Merchandise Determination Pursuant to Court Decision; Correction
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部10月2日发布更正（A-570-814；91 FR 62700），补入8月28日公告遗漏的追溯执行段落。对在中国形成粗坯、在越南完成第二或第三阶段加工且物理特征相同的相关产品：已暂停的条目继续暂停并适用相应现金保证金；尚未暂停且未清算的条目，2022年9月26日及以后进口的须暂停清算并缴纳保证金；2021年11月4日之后、2022年9月26日之前进口且仍未清算的条目亦同。该认定按同一国家的出口商或进口商层面适用。
items.summary_en: Commerce's 2 October correction (A-570-814; 91 FR 62700) adds omitted retroactive implementation language to the 28 August notice. For China-formed rough shapes completed through second or third production stages in Vietnam and sharing the relevant physical characteristics, CBP is to continue existing suspensions and apply cash deposits; suspend still-unliquidated entries on or after 26 September 2022; and also suspend still-unliquidated entries after 4 November 2021 but before 26 September 2022, at the applicable rate. The finding applies on a country-wide exporter or importer basis.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：更正没有公布统一新税率，但显著扩大了需要追溯核对的未清算条目范围。相关出口商、越南加工商和美国进口商应立即按两个日期区间筛查历史未清算进口，核对保证金及海关指令，并保存粗坯物理特征、加工和原产链证据。
items.impact_en: Assessment: the correction sets no uniform new rate but materially clarifies the historical unliquidated entries subject to suspension. Exporters, Vietnamese processors and US importers should screen entries against both date windows, verify cash-deposit and CBP instructions, and preserve evidence on rough-shape characteristics, processing and origin.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice to the public in the Federal Register of August 28, 2026 that the U.S. Court of International Trade's (CIT) final judgment was not in harmony with Commerce's covered merchandise inquiry (CMI) determination. Specifically, Commerce amended the CMI determination to find that products cut to length and formed into the rough shape of certain carbon steel butt-weld pipe fittings (butt-weld pipe fittings) in the People's Republic of China (China) represent "unfinished" fittings, which are covered by the scope of the Order, and that when such products are further processed in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam), they remain subject to the antidumping (AD) order on butt- weld pipe fittings from China. This notice did not provide clear notice to parties that the liquidation of entries of these unfinished fittings will be retroactively suspended.
items.coverage: Official Federal Register correction and the linked 28 August notice checked; date windows are limited to still-unliquidated covered entries.

items.title_zh: WTO成立欧盟CBAM争端专家组，中国保留第三方权利
items.title_en: WTO establishes panel on EU CBAM; China reserves third-party rights
items.title_original: WTO establishes CBAM dispute panel at Russia's request
items.summary_zh: WTO争端解决机构于2026年9月25日就俄罗斯诉欧盟案DS639成立专家组，审查欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）及俄罗斯所称欧盟排放交易体系下的出口补贴是否符合WTO义务。俄罗斯于2025年5月12日请求磋商、2026年7月10日请求设组；中国等成员保留第三方权利。专家组成立只是争端程序启动，尚无裁决。
items.summary_en: On 25 September 2026 the WTO DSB established a panel in DS639, Russia's challenge to the EU CBAM package and an alleged export subsidy under the EU ETS. Russia requested consultations on 12 May 2025 and a panel on 10 July 2026. China and other members reserved third-party rights. Panel establishment begins adjudication; no ruling has been issued.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：DS639不会自动暂停CBAM，欧盟现行申报、授权申报人和证书义务仍应照常准备。中国钢企可跟踪中国作为第三方提交的法律主张和后续报告，但当前不应据此延后碳数据、核证或客户合规安排。
items.impact_en: Assessment: DS639 does not automatically suspend CBAM. Existing EU reporting, authorised-declarant and certificate preparations should continue. Chinese steel exporters should monitor China's third-party submissions and later reports, but should not delay emissions-data, verification or customer-compliance work.
items.source_excerpt: WTO establishes CBAM dispute panel at Russia's request Kallanish
items.coverage: WTO DS639 case page and 25 September DSB news item checked; the collected media item is used only as the discovery record.

items.summary_zh: 欧委会10月1日确认EEX已发布2027年ETS1修订拍卖日历和首份ETS2拍卖日历。ETS1增加2500万份划拨希腊脱碳基金的配额；当前ETS2拍卖量含1.4亿份社会气候基金配额，年内还将因成员国立法进展调整。共同拍卖平台的ETS1和ETS2拍卖分别于2027年1月7日和1月18日开始。
items.summary_en: On 1 October the Commission confirmed EEX's revised 2027 ETS1 and first ETS2 auction calendars. ETS1 adds 25 million allowances for the Greek Decarbonisation Fund; the current ETS2 volume includes 140 million allowances for the Social Climate Fund and will be adjusted as national legislation progresses. Auctions start on 7 and 18 January 2027 respectively.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：这是配额拍卖供应安排，不是钢铁CBAM证书价格、免费分配或清缴规则的调整。可作为2027年欧盟碳价和客户采购预算的市场信息跟踪，不应直接换算为钢材CBAM税额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: this concerns allowance auction supply, not a change to steel CBAM certificate pricing, free allocation or surrender rules. Use it as a 2027 carbon-market input, not as a direct steel CBAM charge.
items.source_excerpt: Yesterday, the European Energy Exchange (EEX) published the revised 2027 EU ETS1 and the new 2027 EU ETS2 auction calendars. The published calendar for ETS1 allowances reflects the addition of 25 million allowances allocated to the Greek Decarbonisation Fund pursuant to Article 10a(9) of the ETS Directive . The first published calendar for ETS2 allowances reflects the early auctioning of 2028 volumes in accordance with Article 8(5) of the Auctioning Regulation . Pursuant to Article 13(7) of the Auctioning Regulation, the current auction volume for 2027 includes 140 000 000 allowances allocated to the Social Climate Fund and allowances allocated to Member States that have implemented in their national legislation the obligation of regulated entities to surrender allowances and the penalties for excess emissions. Several Members States are finalising or have finalised the implementation of the surrender obligation and the penalties in their national legislation after the determination o…

items.title_original: UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026
items.summary_zh: 英国官方页面10月1日更新，移除非合金钢丝税号72173049、72173090，将这两项措施税率从50%降至0%，第28类配额量不变。其余7月1日起执行的20类钢材制度总体配额较旧保障措施减少51%，超配额税率50%；旧25%保障措施于6月30日停止。第1类热轧板带还有授权用途安排，乌克兰原产货物适用单独优惠条件。
items.summary_en: The 1 October update removes wire codes 72173049 and 72173090, reducing their measure rate from 50% to 0% without changing category 28 quotas. The July regime otherwise reduces overall quotas by 51% with a 50% out-of-quota tariff across 20 categories. Category 1 has authorised-use arrangements; Ukraine has separate origin-conditioned preferences.
items.impact_zh: 钢丝出口商应立即核对归类与新报价；移出本措施不等于免除所有其他关税或贸易救济。其他钢材订单须核对配额、原产地和授权用途，尤其热轧第1类，不能直接套用旧25%费率。本研判仅适用10月1日版本，旧7月2日记录不套用新版结论。
items.impact_en: Wire exporters should check classification and quotations immediately. Exclusion does not remove other applicable duties. Other shipments require quota, origin and authorised-use checks. This brief applies only to the 1 October revision.

items.summary_zh: 英国政府10月1日更新钢铁贸易措施，将非合金钢丝商品编码72173049和72173090移出适用范围，对应税率由50%降为0%；Category 28配额量保持不变。其他纳入范围的产品配额外税率仍为50%。
items.summary_en: The UK updated its steel trade measure on 1 October, removing non-alloy wire codes 72173049 and 72173090. Their tariff falls from 50% to 0%; Category 28 quota volumes are unchanged. The 50% out-of-quota tariff remains for other covered products.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：涉及上述两个编码的在途和新订单应立即复核英国报关税率及商品归类；该变化不适用于Category 28其他钢丝编码，也没有增加剩余配额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: recheck UK classification and entry treatment for shipments under these two codes. The change does not cover other Category 28 wire codes or increase the remaining quota.
items.source_excerpt: Details about a new steel trade measure from 1 July 2026, which limits tariff-free steel import quota volumes. On 19 March 2026, the government announced a new steel trade measure , taking effect from 1 July 2026. This measure has been implemented using powers in the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2018 , as amended. The government has carried out a programme of intensive industry engagement since the announcement. We have also engaged closely with the European Union ( EU ) ahead of their new steel trade measure coming into effect and agreed an approach that reflects the UK and EU ’s highly interconnected supply chains. From 1 July 2026, the government is limiting tariff-free steel imports, reducing overall quota volumes by 51% compared with the steel safeguard measure. Any imports above these levels will face a 50% tariff. The measure applies to imports of steel products that can also be made in the UK. The steel safeguard quotas and the 25% additional safeguard duty ceased to appl…

items.summary_zh: 美国商务部10月1日启动8月周年月的反倾销/反补贴行政复审。其中对华涉钢项目包括钢钉A-570-909（复审期2025年8月1日至2026年7月31日）、制动鼓A-570-174/C-570-175及金属储物柜A-570-133/C-570-134。公告预计最终结果不晚于2027年8月31日。
items.summary_en: Commerce's 1 October omnibus notice opens August-anniversary AD/CVD reviews. China-related steel cases include steel nails A-570-909 (POR 1 August 2025–31 July 2026), brake drums A-570-174/C-570-175 and metal lockers A-570-133/C-570-134. Final results are intended by 31 August 2027.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：被列名企业应让美国律师立即核对独立税率申请或证明、Q&V问卷及APO等个案期限；独立税率材料原则上须在公告后14个日历日内提交。此次是复审立案，不是新税率终裁。
items.impact_en: Assessment: listed firms should have US counsel check separate-rate applications/certifications, Q&V questionnaires and APO deadlines immediately. Separate-rate filings are generally due within 14 calendar days of publication. This is review initiation, not a new final rate.
